Class Server

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Network.Server.Server
public class Server extends Object
This class is responsible for starting the network server and listening for incoming client requests. It manages multiple concurrent games and routes each client request to the correct game instance based on the client's name. It ensures that actions are executed within the appropriate game context.

  • Constructor Details

    • Server

      public Server() throws Exception
      Initializes a new instance of the Server class. This constructor sets up the server by prompting the user to input a valid IPv4 address, initializes the TCP and RMI servers, and prepares various data structures required for managing game instances, connected clients, and scheduling tasks. The constructor also initiates a periodic check to monitor client connectivity by collecting pings.
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during the server setup or initialization process

    • onClientConnection

      public void onClientConnection(VirtualView clientVirtualView) throws Exception
      Handles a new client connection by retrieving all currently configured games and sending this information to the client. This allows the client to choose one of the following actions:
      • Join an existing game
      • Create a new game
      • Reconnect to a previous game using a nickname
      Parameters:
      clientVirtualView - the virtual view associated with the connected client
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs while retrieving or sending game information

    • searchForGames

      private Map<Integer,GameInstance> searchForGames()
      Filters and retrieves a map of game instances that are available to be joined by players. The method ensures thread safety by synchronizing on the gameInstances collection.
      Returns:
      a map where the key is the game ID (Integer) and the value is the game instance (GameInstance) of all currently available games that can be joined.

    • createNewGame

      public void createNewGame(String playerNickname, PlayerColor playerColor, int gameLevel, int totalPlayers, VirtualView clientView) throws Exception
      Creates a new game and initializes its configuration, adding the specified player to the game and mapping relevant client information to manage the game instance. This method ensures thread safety for the involved data structures.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player creating the game
      playerColor - the color chosen by the player
      gameLevel - the difficulty level of the game
      totalPlayers - the total number of players for the game
      clientView - the virtual view associated with the client creating the game
      Throws:
      Exception - if the specified nickname is already being used or if an error occurs during game creation

    • joinGame

      public void joinGame(String playerNickname, PlayerColor playerColor, int gameID, VirtualView clientView) throws Exception
      Allows a player to join an existing game instance. This method manages the addition of a new player to the specified game, ensuring thread-safe operations for handling connected clients, game instances, and ping utilities associated with the client.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player attempting to join the game
      playerColor - the color chosen by the player
      gameID - the unique identifier of the game the player intends to join
      clientView - the virtual view associated with the client
      Throws:
      Exception - if the player's nickname is already in use or if an error occurs while adding the player to the game

    • placeTile

      public void placeTile(String playerNickname, Integer componentID, Integer i, Integer j, Integer rotation) throws Exception
      Places a tile on the game board for a specified player. This method ensures thread safety while accessing the game instance associated with the player, updating the game state accordingly. The placement includes the tile's position (row and column) and orientation.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player placing the tile
      componentID - the unique identifier of the tile being placed
      i - the row index where the tile is placed
      j - the column index where the tile is placed
      rotation - the rotation applied to the tile during placement
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during the tile placement process

    • playerEndedSendShip

      public void playerEndedSendShip(String playerNickname, int reservedTiles) throws Exception
      Notifies the server that a player has ended their ship creation process and indicates the number of reserved tiles. This method ensures thread safety while accessing game instances and updates the game's state accordingly.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player signaling the end of their ship creation
      reservedTiles - the number of tiles reserved and not used by the player during ship creation
      Throws:

    • selectDeselectSubdeck

      public void selectDeselectSubdeck(String playerNickname, int subdeck, boolean isSelectAction) throws Exception
      Handles the selection or deselection of a specific subdeck for a player. This method retrieves the game instance associated with the player's nickname and updates the game state based on the action (select or deselect). Thread safety is ensured by synchronizing access to the game instances data structure.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player performing the action
      subdeck - the identifier of the subdeck being selected or deselected
      isSelectAction - a boolean value indicating the action to be performed; true for selecting the subdeck, false for deselecting it
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during the process, such as the inability to retrieve the game instance or invalid player actions

    • checkClientsConnection

      private void checkClientsConnection()
      Periodically checks the connection status of all connected clients every 5 seconds. If a client is found to be disconnected, it is marked as disconnected in the game it was participating in.
